comment: No parameter, input or output is given a name: every configParam call passes an empty string and there are no configInput or configOutput calls at all, so Rack's tooltips are blank on the whole panel. The DRY/WET law is not a crossfade: d = clamp(1 - mix, 0, 1) and w = clamp(1 + mix, 0, 1) with mix running -1 to +1, so the centre position passes the untreated signal and the program's output both at full level, summed. When w reaches 0 the emulator is not run at all that sample. The three control CV jacks are scaled by 0.1 before their attenuverters while the DRY/WET jack is not scaled at all, so a volt reaches two and a half times further there in proportion to its knob's travel. The input trims multiply by (1 + value) over a -1 to +1 parameter, so the anticlockwise end silences that input. The back-arrow branch reads `if (--selectedProgram <= 0) selectedProgram = programs.size() - 1`, which skips index 0. The plugin ships only fx/demo.spn and fx/README.TXT; there is no programs.json in the installed folder. The display's draw() uses Rack's deprecated NVGcontext* signature, which still works.
